AggregateTransform.description: An aggregate transform that combines multiple values.

argmax.description: Find a value of the first column that maximizes the second column.

argmin.description: Find a value of the first column that minimizes the second column.

Avg.description: An avg (average, or mean) aggregate transform.

avg.description: Compute the average (mean) value of the given column.

bin.description: Bin a continuous variable into discrete intervals. The bin argument specifies a data column or expression to bin. Both numerical and temporal (date/time) values are supported.

interval.description: The interval bin unit to use, typically used to indicate a date/time unit for binning temporal values, such as `hour`, `day`, or `month`. If `date`, the extent of data values is used to automatically select an interval for temporal data. The value `number` enforces normal numerical binning, even over temporal data. If unspecified, defaults to `number` for numerical data and `date` for temporal data.

minstep.description: The minimum allowed bin step size (default `0`) when performing numerical binning. For example, a setting of `1` prevents step sizes less than 1. This option is ignored when **step** is specified.

nice.description: A flag (default `true`) requesting "nice" human-friendly end points and step sizes when performing numerical binning. When **step** is specified, this option affects the binning end points (e.g., origin) only.

offset.description: Offset for computed bins (default `0`). For example, a value of `1` will result in using the next consecutive bin boundary.

step.description: The step size to use between bins. When binning numerical values (or interval type `number`), this setting specifies the numerical step size. For data/time intervals, this indicates the number of steps of that unit, such as hours, days, or years.

steps.description: The target number of binning steps to use. To accommodate human-friendly ("nice") bin boundaries, the actual number of bins may diverge from this exact value. This option is ignored when **step** is specified.

centroid.description: Compute the 2D centroid of geometry-typed data. This transform requires the DuckDB `spatial` extension.

centroidX.description: Compute the centroid x-coordinate of geometry-typed data. This transform requires the DuckDB `spatial` extension.

centroidY.description: Compute the centroid y-coordinate of geometry-typed data. This transform requires the DuckDB `spatial` extension.

column.description: Interpret a string or param-value as a column reference.

ColumnTransform.description: A data transform that maps one column value to another.

count.description: Compute the count of records in an aggregation group.

cume_dist.description: Compute the cumulative distribution value over an ordered window partition. Equals the number of partition rows preceding or peer with the current row, divided by the total number of partition rows.

dateDay.description: Transform a Date value to a day of the month for cyclic comparison. Year and month values are collapsed to enable comparison over days only.

dateMonth.description: Transform a Date value to a month boundary for cyclic comparison. Year values are collapsed to enable comparison over months only.

dateMonthDay.description: Transform a Date value to a month and day boundary for cyclic comparison. Year values are collapsed to enable comparison over months and days only.

Days.description: A date/time interval in units of days.

days.description: A date/time interval in units of days.

dense_rank.description: Compute the dense row rank (no gaps) over an ordered window partition. Sorting ties do not result in gaps in the rank numbers ([1, 1, 2, ...]).

first.description: Return the first column value found in an aggregation group.

first_value.description: Get the first value of the given column in the current window frame.

geojson.description: Compute a GeoJSON-formatted string from geometry-typed data. This transform requires the DuckDB `spatial` extension.

Hours.description: A date/time interval in units of hours.

hours.description: A date/time interval in units of hours.

lag.description: Compute lagging values in a column. Returns the value at the row that is `offset` (second argument, default `1`) rows before the current row within the window frame. If there is no such row, instead return `default` (third argument, default `null`). Both offset and default are evaluated with respect to the current row.

last.description: Return the last column value found in an aggregation group.

last_value.description: Get the last value of the given column in the current window frame.

lead.description: Compute leading values in a column. Returns the value at the row that is `offset` (second argument, default `1`) rows after the current row within the window frame. If there is no such row, instead return `default` (third argument, default `null`). Both offset and default are evaluated with respect to the current row.

max.description: Compute the maximum value of the given column.

median.description: Compute the median value of the given column.

Microseconds.description: A date/time interval in units of microseconds.

microseconds.description: A date/time interval in units of microseconds.

Milliseconds.description: A date/time interval in units of milliseconds.

milliseconds.description: A date/time interval in units of milliseconds.

min.description: Compute the minimum value of the given column.

Minutes.description: A date/time interval in units of minutes.

minutes.description: A date/time interval in units of minutes.

mode.description: Compute the mode value of the given column.

Months.description: A date/time interval in units of months.

months.description: A date/time interval in units of months.

ntile.description: Compute an n-tile integer ranging from 1 to the provided argument (num_buckets), dividing the partition as equally as possible.

nth_value.description: Get the nth value of the given column in the current window frame, counting from one. The second argument is the offset for the nth row.

percent_rank.description: Compute the percentage rank over an ordered window partition.

product.description: Compute the product of the given column.

quantile.description: Compute the quantile value of the given column at the provided probability threshold. For example, 0.5 is the median.

rank.description: Compute the row rank over an ordered window partition. Sorting ties result in gaps in the rank numbers ([1, 1, 3, ...]).

row_number.description: Compute the 1-based row number over an ordered window partition.

Seconds.description: A date/time interval in units of seconds.

seconds.description: A date/time interval in units of seconds.

Stddev.description: A sample standard deviation aggregate transform.

stddev.description: Compute the sum of the given column.

StddevPop.description: A population standard deviation aggregate transform.

stddevPop.description: Compute the sum of the given column.

sum.description: Compute the sum of the given column.

TransformField.description: A field argument to a data transform.

varPop.description: Compute the population variance of the given column.

variance.description: Compute the sample variance of the given column.

WindowTransform.description: A window transform that operates over a sorted domain.

Years.description: A date/time interval in units of years.

years.description: A date/time interval in units of years.
